newsitem.title: USA: Imo Industries hires financial adviser.
newsitem.headline: Imo Industries hires financial adviser.

text.p: Imo Industries Inc said Friday it has hired Credit Suisse First Boston to help it evaluate strategic alternatives for enhancing shareholder value and reducing leverage.
The company said it would explore the possibility of a merger or sale but no decision has been made yet to enter into any kind of transaction.
"Investors should not assume that the process will result in board of directors approval of any particular transaction or type of transaction," said Donald Farrar, Imo chairman and chief executive.
